name: Junlong Jia
intro: My research focuses on long-context modeling and multimodal large language models.
bio: I am a Ph.D. student in the School of Artificial Intelligence at Beihang University. I am interested in making language and vision-language models more effective and efficient through better data, training methods, and evaluation. My work spans long-context data synthesis, context extension, and small-scale multimodal models.
introZh: 我的研究方向是长上下文建模与多模态大语言模型。
bioZh: 我是北京航空航天大学人工智能学院的博士研究生。我关注如何通过改进数据、训练方法和评测，提升语言模型与视觉语言模型的效果和效率。我的工作涵盖长上下文数据合成、上下文扩展，以及小规模多模态模型。
